component.name: ruro studio
component.summary: Design, run and inspect robotics dataflow graphs

description.p: ruro is a fast, lightweight robotics dataflow platform written in Rust. A robot's software is built as a graph of small nodes (drivers, perception, control) that exchange typed messages: zero-copy between nodes in the same process and through shared memory between processes.
ruro studio is the native editor for these graphs:

ul.li: Build graphs from a library of typed nodes; invalid wires are rejected as you draw them
Run a graph locally or on a robot over the network, with one click
Watch any output live as an image, plot or value
Tune node parameters while the graph is running
See per-node rate, latency, CPU, drops and errors at a glance

screenshot.caption: A camera pipeline running in the editor

description.p: First release: runtime, node SDK, daemon, command-line tools and studio.
